title: In-App Update Helper Compose Environment Dofix
summary: Fixes in-app update helper compose detection on NAS installations where the host terminal update uses a vendor docker-compose path that is not available inside the update-helper container.
changelog: Separates host terminal Docker Compose configuration from update-helper container Compose execution.
Adds KM_VMS_UPDATE_HELPER_DOCKER_COMPOSE for the in-app update helper with docker-compose as the safe container default.
Prevents host-only NAS compose paths from breaking update-helper preflight inside the container.
Adds regression coverage for the host-path versus helper-container compose environment contract.
